title: Smooth pullback is perverse up to the shift
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth
morphism of constant relative dimension $d$ between separated schemes
of finite type over a field $k$. On the constructible
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$-coefficient categories of
[def-weil-pbc-qbar-category], the functor $Lf^*[d]$ is exact for
the candidate subcategories of [def-per-perverse-subcategories]:

$$
Lf^*[d]\bigl({}^pD^{\le0}(Y)\bigr)\subset{}^pD^{\le0}(X),\qquad
Lf^*[d]\bigl({}^pD^{\ge0}(Y)\bigr)\subset{}^pD^{\ge0}(X).
$$

proof.text: For the $\le$-direction, let $K\in{}^pD^{\le0}(Y)$. The object $Lf^*K[d]$ lies in $D^b_c(X,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ by the constructible domain of pullback in [prop-functor-package]. By [def-per-perverse-subcategories] and [def-per-support-condition], $K$ satisfies $\dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-j}(K)\le j$ for every integer $j$. For an integer $i$, apply [lem-per-smooth-pullback-support-dimension] and then the hypothesis with $j=i-d$: $\dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-i}(Lf^*K[d])\le\dim\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal H^{-i+d}(K)+d\le(i-d)+d=i$ (with $-\infty+d=-\infty$ for empty support). Thus $\operatorname{SuppCon}(Lf^*K[d])$, hence $Lf^*[d]K\in{}^pD^{\le0}(X)$. The same argument applies to every $K'\in D^b_c(Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ with $\operatorname{SuppCon}(K')$.

For the $\ge$-direction, let $K\in D^b_c(Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$. The duality against pullback of [cor-sf-duality-pullback], for the separated finite-type morphism $f$, gives the canonical isomorphism $D_X(Lf^*K)\cong Rf^!(D_YK)$, where $D_YK\in D^b_c(Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ by the $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ Verdier clause of [prop-functor-package]. Smooth purity for $f$ of relative dimension $d$ (clause 6 of [prop-functor-package]) gives $Rf^!(D_YK)\cong Lf^*(D_YK)(d)[2d]$. Since $D_X(M[d])=R\mathcal Hom(M[d],\omega_X)\cong R\mathcal Hom(M,\omega_X)[-d]=D_X(M)[-d]$, composing gives the canonical isomorphism $$D_X\bigl(Lf^*[d]K\bigr)\cong D_X(Lf^*K)[-d]\cong Lf^*\bigl(D_YK\bigr)(d)[d].$$

source.place: The Verdier exchange and smooth purity paragraph

proof.text: If $K\in{}^pD^{\ge0}(Y)$, then [def-per-perverse-subcategories] and [def-per-support-condition] give $\operatorname{SuppCon}(D_YK)$, with $D_YK\in D^b_c(Y,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell)$ as in Step 2. Applying [lem-per-smooth-pullback-support-dimension] to $D_YK$ exactly as in Step 1 (the inequality for $D_YK$ at index $i-d$ gives the inequality at index $i$ after the shift $[d]$) gives $\operatorname{SuppCon}(Lf^*(D_YK)[d])$. By [lem-per-tate-twist-support-condition] with $m=d$, $\operatorname{SuppCon}\bigl((Lf^*(D_YK)[d])(d)\bigr)$, and $(M[d])(d)\cong M(d)[d]$ because the twist is a derived tensor product with a complex in degree $0$. Isomorphic complexes have isomorphic cohomology sheaves, so the isomorphism of Step 2 gives $\operatorname{SuppCon}(D_X(Lf^*[d]K))$, hence $Lf^*[d]K\in{}^pD^{\ge0}(X)$ by [def-per-support-condition] and [def-per-perverse-subcategories].
